annotation.summary_en: Index listing of statements submitted to the 2024 CCW Group of Governmental Experts on lethal autonomous weapons systems, from states, the ICRC, the Campaign to Stop Killer Robots, ICRAC and the Holy See, covering definitions, IHL application and risk mitigation. Only titles and dates are shown.
key_provisions_or_claims: Lists statements from the March and August 2024 GGE LAWS sessions
Topics include characterizations and definitions, IHL application, risk mitigation and confidence building
Contributors include states, the ICRC, Campaign to Stop Killer Robots, ICRAC and the Holy See
Includes the Chairperson's concluding remarks for the first session
